claims.statement: All primary base operator tables came from a test partition disjoint from train and development partitions.
The joint arm reached mean D4 accuracy 0.8660 at depth 64 and 0.6105 at depth 128 after training only through depth 4.
Correct composition targets beat shuffled targets on long-depth behavior and closure residuals, but absolute closure gates failed.
The joint state contracted to a mean median endpoint/start G-norm ratio of 0.001281 at depth 128.
Composition substitution, direct/sequential agreement, and intrinsic closure residual missed their absolute gates.
Cross-context patch accuracy 0.4146 exceeded the on-manifold wrong-state control 0.0805 but failed the frozen accuracy and margin gates.
Affine alignment achieved 0.9848 D4 continuation accuracy versus 0.1406 shuffled-fit and 0.0809 random-map controls.
Decode-to-label then target re-embedding reached 0.9922 and equaled or exceeded affine transport in every pair.
The architecture and supplied full transition tables explicitly bias the system toward matrix-operator execution.
